title: campuloclinium barrosoana
intro: Campuloclinium barrosoana, commonly known as Barroso's campuloclinium, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Brazil, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various conditions, including wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Campuloclinium barrosoana include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
